service.en: Work permit for UAE national trainees
service.ur: یو اے ای شہری تربیت یافتگان کا ورک پرمٹ

about: Get a work permit for a UAE national trainee at a private-sector employer.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Trainee is at least 18 and holds no valid work permit
Contract runs up to 12 months, renewable by agreement, and states the trainee's qualifications
Establishment has a valid licence with no violations
Applied for by the establishment's authorised signatory
documents: Clear colour photo on a white background
Official job offer form signed by employer and employee
Professional licence from the competent authority where the job needs one
fees: Business centres may add a commission of up to 72 AED
Otherwise free on the website and app; tax and collection charges are extra
